cited.quote: So far, 795 causeways have been converted into High level bridges
Construction of 648 Nos. of High Level Bridges in lieu of existing causeway structures taken up
Construction of 34 Bridge works based on the Ungal Thoguthiyil Muthalamaichar, Flood-affected areas

rationale: C2 and C3 (undated) show causeways being replaced by high-level bridges, 795 converted, but not all crossings. C4 is the only dated GO sanctioning high-level bridges for flood-affected areas (2024-12-17); earlier steps are undated, so the date is uncertain. Partial: conversion is under way, not complete statewide.

cited.quote: have sanctioned a sum of Rs.85 crore to construct 5,000 houses to inland and marine fisherfolk
Construction of 4,069 houses for fisherman at an estimated cost of Rs.69.17 crore under the Blue Revolution
Fishermen Welfare Conference held on 18.08.2023 at Ramanathapuram District, Government of Tamil Nadu has enhanced the unit cost

rationale: C1 and C2 show fishermen housing on a scale of about 5,000 and 4,069 houses, far below 2 lakh, so the scope is materially reduced. The earliest dated post-takeover step is the unit-cost enhancement and additional sanction after 18.08.2023 (C3). The original sanction dates are not shown, so the date is uncertain.

cited.quote: have sanctioned a sum of Rs.85 crore to construct 5,000 houses to inland and marine fisherfolk
Fishermen Welfare Conference held on 18.08.2023 at Ramanathapuram District, Government of Tamil Nadu has enhanced the unit cost

rationale: C2 shows a fishermen housing scheme for 5,000 houses (3,308 completed), far below 2 lakh, so the scope is materially reduced. C4 reports the unit-cost enhancement and additional sanction following 18.08.2023, the only dated step. The original sanction date is not shown. C1, C3 and C5 are about other schemes.

cited.quote: 14 new Uzhavar Sandhais have been established at a cost of Rs.7.53 crore and are functioning
50 Uzhavar Sandhais will be identified and they will be given facelift

rationale: C1 (budget, 2021-09-29) only announces a facelift. C2 reports existing Uzhavar Sandhais refurbished and 14 new ones established and functioning, so both revitalisation and expansion happened. No GO dates the step, so the date is that of C2, the earliest dated evidence of operation (an upper bound).

cited.quote: Conference on 18.08.2023 at Ramanathapuram, the Government have increased the fishing ban relief assistance from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.8,000/-
Special allowance of Rs.5,000/- to marine fishermen families during lean fishing season

rationale: C1 and C2 show the fishing ban relief raised from Rs.5,000 to Rs.8,000 following the 18.08.2023 announcement, with disbursement in 2024-25. No extract shows the monsoon/lean-season relief raised to Rs.8,000 (C4 shows Rs.5,000). Partial; the date is the year of the increase as reported in C2.
